blocks.text: TO MY CAPSTONE PARTNERS, AND THE ELECT— ‘Let us look for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the ‘great God and our Saviour’ Jesus Christ!”’ (Titus 2:13).

“IN THIS SCRIPT WE WANT TO BRING OUT VERY IM- PORTANT THINGS TO THE ELECT CHURCH! We are living in an age where more spellbinders are rising with false signs preparing the way for the beast system; wherein a skillful chief wizard known as the anti-christ will totally control the masses as in the form of ultra magic! — A super charmer is on his way! At first a very religious and cunning personality, but in the end reverts back into idols and abomination!”’ ( Rev. 13:13-18) — “‘If you don’t believe that it’s a real sharp crafty delusion”’ (religious too) then read St. Matt. 24:24 where it says, ‘‘if it were possible they shall deceive the very elect!’’ And this is speaking of just the anti-christ forerunners and not of himself! — ‘‘But the elect will not be deceived, but will be translated before it goes into full wizardry in his full beast form!’’ — ‘‘In all my writings I’m trying to show the different aspects to this system that will come! Read on, we have some interesting things to reveal.”’

MICAH 5:12-13, ““SSHOWS GOD WILL CUT OFF WITCH- CRAFT AND THE SOOTHSAYERS, He will also cut the graven images and idols off! — It’s coming into prominence that more and more church people are dabbling into anything that is supernatural whether it has any Scriptural foundation or not!’? — I Tim. 4:1, ‘‘Now the spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils! People start off with small amounts of witchcraft not knowing that is what it is at first, then they are taken over by spirits that actually talk to them! — When traveling in earlier Crusades many of these kinds of cases would come to me and God would cast out the spirits and they were healed! Only the power of God can heal such cases!’’ — Deut. 18:10, — “There shall not be found among you those that sacrifice their children through fire, nor that useth divination, nor an observer of time, nor an enchanter or witch! In Bible times they used strange and odd ways to try to tell the people’s future and so forth (known today as fortune tellers). The Bible continues, or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer!’’

““AN ENCHANTER IS A CHARMER OF EVIL!”’— ‘‘A wizard we already described!’’ — ‘‘Familiar spirits is all kinds of sorcery or casting of spells, etc.’” — ‘‘A necromancer is one that communicates with the dead’’ Isa. 8:19-20, ‘‘When they shall say unto you, seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? For the living to the dead? To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word it is because there is no light in them!’ — ‘In other words, if you want to know anything, seek God’s true prophet or go directly to the Lord yourself!’’ — ‘I Chron. 10:13-14, So Saul died for his transgression for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire of it, and the witch of Endor enquired not of the Lord!’’ — ‘‘Today these same practices, even drinking of blood, weird rituals in association with drugs, religious prostitution on altars of abomination have been seen in different areas of the country!’’ — ““Even in some Bible references it claims intercourse with familiar spirits and muttering to the dead, contacting demons will be prevalent as the age closes!’’ — ‘‘Plus orgiastic rituals, etc.!’? — Ezek. 16:20-21, ‘‘shows how far this wicked debauchery can go when reaching its final course. Wherein the Lord speaks about them sacrificing their children in the fire! Plus in old times satan used sex and perversion inter-mingled with idols to lead the people astray in strange madness! This occurs in the false church at the end.”’ Rev. 17:1-5! — In others words these idols promoted and okayed these types of rituals! Now in Rev. 18:2, it speaks of Babylon becoming the habitation of devils and every foul spirit and hateful bird! — The age truly will end in confusion and utter delusion, and in an incoherent stupor worshipping and following the beast! (Rev. 13:3-6).

“YOU MIGHT SAY ALL THE FALSE IN SOME FORM OR ANOTHER IMITATES THE REAL TRUE GIFTS OF GOD!— And before we finish we must bring out that there is a real supernatural power of the Lord that works in His divine gifts as found in I Cor. 12:1-10!’’ — ‘‘The Lord Jesus through gifts can foretell a person’s future, past or present! Or gifts to work miracles and healing on sick bodies, or even over nature, also even into creation!’ — ‘The spiritual gift of knowledge can tell the person’s name, what country they came from, or what disease they have, etc. Jesus among others called His disciples by name through this gift! And He said in St. John 14:12, we would be able to do through His gifts the same kind of works that He did!’? — ‘‘In Acts 16:16-18 Paul had a gift of discerning of spirits, and cast a divination spirit out of one in a certain place!’’ — ‘‘We would like to elaborate more, but you can see that there are true gifts of the Lord which set a standard up against the false!’’ — ‘‘A word of wisdom, if any Christian comes up against any false witchcraft or spirits just plead the blood of the Lord Jesus and the evil will vanish!”’ :

“THE REAL CHRISTIAN WHO FOLLOWS THE WORD and the Lord’s true servants will have no trouble with witchcraft! Stay true to His Word is the answer! I Cor. 12:28, shows the powerful ministerial gifts set forth in the church!’’ — ‘‘Let us close with this wise Scripture I John 4:1-3, Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whither they are of God! In other words try them against the true Word of God to see if they are valid! If they can’t take the full Word of the Lord then you know they are not true!”’

PAUL POINTS OUT THAT THE CHIEF RELIGIOUS WIZARD OF ALL TIME WILL EXALT HIMSELF IN THE TEMPLE OF GOD with ultra magic proclaiming that he is God! (II Thess. 2:4) — “But the real invincible God (our champion Jesus) shall, with the spirit of His mouth, destroy the false god with the brightness of His coming!” (verse 8) — Verse 9, ‘‘gives
__us another dimension of this anti-christ whose coming is after the

working of satan with all power, signs and lying wonders!’? — “As we said before, these spellbinders set it up for his appearance! And a strong delusion is sent forth to deceive the unbelievers!”’ (verse 11) — II Tim. 4:3-4, “‘All because they would not endure sound doctrine, and heap to themselves teachers having itching ears! They quit the truth and went into fables! And the false religious systems were gobbled up into Rev. 17, and deceived by her sorceries!’’ Rev. 18:23.

A FINAL WORD— EPH. 6:13 — “Take the whole armour that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day and having done all to stand!’’ — Verse 11, ‘‘Against the wiles of the devil! Now the apostle Paul gives us some good advice in revealing to us who Jesus is!”’ Titus 2:10, latter part, “‘That they may adorn the doctrine of ‘God our Saviour’ in all things!’ Also verse 13, “at the top of the scroll gives essential evidence and Titus 3:4, But after that the kidness and love of ‘God our Saviour’ toward all man appeared!’ Amen! ‘‘Jesus our all wise Saviour and God bless you!
